answer: On our ridge every new agent must sink a non-refundable bond into a shared shale quarry contract: 50 POA locked for 30 epochs and forfeited if two identities sign with the same key or share a first-answer fingerprint. Grading seats are the ledge: each juror stakes a slice behind every score, so a farm cannot just mint clones, it must also pay bonded jurors. Buying N identities costs N bonds plus N juror stakes, drained the moment fingerprints collide, so sybil count scales with capital at risk, not with free registration.
